citation: Bodlaender, Cygan, Kratsch, Nederlof, 'Deterministic single exponential time algorithms for connectivity problems parameterized by treewidth', Inf. Comput. 243:86-111, 2015 (ICALP 2013); Cygan et al., 'Parameterized Algorithms', Springer 2015, Sec. 7.3.3 and Ch. 11 (Cut&Count). Planar: Garey & Johnson, SIAM J. Appl. Math. 32(4):826-834, 1977 (Steiner tree NP-complete in planar grid graphs); Borradaile, Klein, Mathieu, 'An O(n log n) approximation scheme for Steiner tree in planar graphs', ACM Trans. Algorithms 5(3):31, 2009; Marx, Pilipczuk, Pilipczuk, FOCS 2018:474-484 (2^{O(sqrt k log k)} on planar). Bounded genus / H-minor-free: Borradaile, Demaine, Tazari, STACS 2009 / Algorithmica 68(2):287-311, 2014; Demaine, Hajiaghayi, Mohar, 'Approximation algorithms via contraction decomposition', Combinatorica 30(5):533-552, 2010.
note: All three fields are established for the pinned edge-weighted terminal-set object.

geometric_embedding: axis-parallel rectangles in a fixed-width strip, no rotation
citation: Baker, Coffman, Rivest, 'Orthogonal packings in two dimensions', SIAM J. Comput. 9(4):846-855, 1980: defines exactly the pinned object (axis-aligned rectangles packed without rotation or overlap into a strip of fixed width, minimising height). Coffman, Garey, Johnson, Tarjan, 'Performance bounds for level-oriented two-dimensional packing algorithms', SIAM J. Comput. 9(4):808-826, 1980.
note: Geometric embedding only; no treewidth, planarity or excluded-minor decomposition result was found for the pinned packing object.

treewidth_bounded_on: bounded treewidth (n^{O(tw)}; W[1]-hard by treewidth, so no FPT)
citation: Ben-Zwi, Hermelin, Lokshtanov, Newman, 'Treewidth governs the complexity of Target Set Selection', Discrete Optimization 8(1):87-96, 2011: n^{O(tw)} algorithm with a matching n^{o(tw)} lower bound, and W[1]-hardness parameterized by treewidth. Planar: Bodlaender & Szilagyi, 'XNLP-Hardness of Parameterized Problems on Planar Graphs', WG 2024, LNCS 15325: Target Set Selection on planar graphs is XNLP-hard parameterized by outerplanarity.
note: Treewidth fact is exact and tight; the planar entry rests on the WG 2024 outerplanarity XNLP-hardness study of planar inputs, and no minor-closed-class result for the pinned threshold-activation object was found.

citation: Dyer & Frieze, 'Planar 3DM is NP-complete', J. Algorithms 7(2):174-184, 1986: 3DM restricted to instances whose associated element-triple bipartite incidence graph is planar remains NP-complete; the paper explicitly names Planar 3DM as a tool for planar NP-completeness proofs (analogous to Planar 3SAT).
note: Only the planar restriction is citable; the planarity is that of the incidence graph of the tripartite hypergraph, and no treewidth or excluded-minor result was found for the pinned perfect-matching decision object.

treewidth_bounded_on: partial k-trees (bounded treewidth): polynomial, later linear time
minor_excluded: bounded genus (surfaces of nonnegative Euler characteristic)
citation: Isobe, Zhou, Nishizeki, 'A polynomial-time algorithm for finding total colorings of partial k-trees', Int. J. Found. Comput. Sci. 10(2):171-194, 1999 (linear-time version: 'A linear algorithm for finding total colorings of partial k-trees', ISAAC 1999, LNCS 1741). Planar: Borodin, 'On the total colouring of planar graphs', J. Reine Angew. Math. 394:180-185, 1989; Kowalik, Sereni, Skrekovski, 'Total-coloring of plane graphs with maximum degree nine', SIAM J. Discrete Math. 22(4):1462-1479, 2008 (chi'' = Delta+1 for plane graphs with Delta >= 9). Surfaces: 'Total coloring of graphs embedded in surfaces of nonnegative Euler characteristic', Science China Mathematics 56, 2013 (chi'' = Delta+1 for Delta >= 9).
note: Treewidth (partial k-trees) and planar facts are firmly sourced; the bounded-genus line is the weakest link, resting on the nonnegative-Euler-characteristic surface results rather than on general genus g.

treewidth_bounded_on: bounded treewidth (O*(3^tw) [sigma,rho]-domination DP)
citation: van Rooij, Bodlaender, Rossmanith, 'Dynamic programming on tree decompositions using generalised fast subset convolution', ESA 2009, LNCS 5757:566-577: O*(3^tw) for Total Dominating Set as a [sigma,rho]-domination problem. Planar: Garnero & Sau, 'A linear kernel for planar total dominating set', Discrete Math. Theor. Comput. Sci. 20(1), 2018: explicit 410k-vertex kernel for Total Dominating Set on planar graphs. Bounded genus: Bodlaender, Fomin, Lokshtanov, Penninkx, Saurabh, Thilikos, '(Meta) kernelization', JACM 63(5):44, 2016 - linear kernels for such domination problems on bounded-genus graphs (the non-constructive meta-theorem that Garnero-Sau make explicit).
note: All facts are stated for the pinned total-domination object (every vertex, including those in S, must have a neighbour in S).

treewidth_bounded_on: partial k-trees / bounded treewidth (polynomial time)
minor_excluded: minor-closed: {G : td(G) <= k} is closed under minors with a finite obstruction set
citation: Bodlaender, Deogun, Jansen, Kloks, Kratsch, Mueller, Tuza, 'Rankings of graphs', SIAM J. Discrete Math. 11(1):168-181, 1998: the vertex ranking number (= treedepth = minimum elimination-tree height) is computable in polynomial time on graphs of treewidth at most k for each fixed k. Minor-closure and finite obstruction sets: Nesetril & Ossona de Mendez, 'Sparsity', Springer 2012, Sec. 6.2; Dvorak, Giannopoulou, Thilikos, 'Forbidden graphs for tree-depth', European J. Combin. 33(5):969-979, 2012.
note: planar_restriction left null: NP-hardness of treedepth on planar graphs is reported open, and the 'vertex ranking of planar graphs' literature (Bose, Dujmovic, Javarsineh, Morin, 2020) concerns ell-rankings with ell >= 2, not treedepth.

treewidth_bounded_on: k-outerplanar (tw <= 3k-1), Baker layering for maximum triangle matching
citation: Baker, 'Approximation algorithms for NP-complete problems on planar graphs', JACM 41(1):153-180, 1994: PTAS on planar graphs for maximum H-matching / maximum triangle matching (vertex-disjoint triangles) via k-outerplanar decomposition solved by DP; Bodlaender, Theor. Comput. Sci. 209(1-2):1-45, 1998: tw(k-outerplanar) <= 3k-1. Planar restriction explicitly named and kernelized: 'An improved kernel for planar vertex-disjoint triangle packing', Theor. Comput. Sci. 2022 (141k-vertex kernel, improving the previous 732k). NP-hardness of the vertex-disjoint triangles problem: Guruswami, Pandu Rangan, Chang, Chang, Wong, WG 1998, LNCS 1517:26-37 (NP-hard on chordal, planar, line and total graphs).
note: Planar Vertex-Disjoint Triangle Packing is an explicitly named and kernelized problem; the treewidth entry is via Baker's layering, and no bounded-genus / H-minor-free packing result was confirmed.

citation: The pinned input is a COMPLETE graph with arbitrary nonnegative weights: tw(K_n) = n-1 (Diestel, 'Graph Theory', 5th ed., Springer 2017, Ch. 12) and K_n is non-planar for n >= 5 (Kuratowski 1930; Wagner 1937), so no planar, minor-excluded or bounded-treewidth restriction of this object exists. The named planar and geometric TSP results are about DIFFERENT objects: Klein, 'A linear-time approximation scheme for TSP in undirected planar graphs with edge-weights', SIAM J. Comput. 37(6):1926-1952, 2008 (shortest-path metric of a planar graph); Arora, JACM 45(5):753-782, 1998 and Mitchell, SIAM J. Comput. 30(2):475-485, 1999 (Euclidean TSP on points in the plane).
note: OBJECT DRIFT: the name evokes planar/Euclidean TSP, but the pinned encoding is the general complete-graph decision version, on which every decomposition restriction is vacuous - the only defensible entry is planar_restriction = false.

treewidth_bounded_on: bounded pathwidth/treewidth (O*(6^pw) DP, SETH-tight); polynomial on generalized series-parallel and bounded clique-width
citation: Dublois, Lampis, Paschos, 'Upper Dominating Set: tight algorithms for pathwidth and sub-exponential approximation', CIAC 2021 / Theor. Comput. Sci. 923:271-291, 2022: O*(6^pw) dynamic programming (improving O*(7^pw)), optimal under SETH. Bazgan, Brankovic, Casel, Fernau, Jansen, Klein, Lampis, Liedloff, Monnot, Paschos, 'The many facets of upper domination', Theor. Comput. Sci. 717:2-25, 2018 (IWOCA 2016): NP-hard on planar cubic graphs and on planar graphs of degree at most 6 with girth at least 6; polynomial on generalized series-parallel graphs and on graphs of bounded clique-width.
note: Both facts are stated for the pinned maximum-cardinality minimal dominating set (upper domination number Gamma(G)); no excluded-minor class result located.

treewidth_bounded_on: bounded treewidth (2^tw * tw^{O(1)} * n DP); planar with tw = O(sqrt k) after the 2k kernel
citation: Cygan, Fomin, Kowalik, Lokshtanov, Marx, Pilipczuk, Pilipczuk, Saurabh, 'Parameterized Algorithms', Springer 2015, Sec. 7.3.1: 2^tw * tw^{O(1)} * n dynamic program for Vertex Cover on a tree decomposition. Planar Vertex Cover NP-complete: Garey, Johnson, Stockmeyer, Theor. Comput. Sci. 1(3):237-267, 1976; Alber, Fernau, Niedermeier, J. Algorithms 52(1):26-56, 2004: 2^{O(sqrt k)} using tw = O(sqrt k) on the kernel. H-minor-free: Demaine, Fomin, Hajiaghayi, Thilikos, 'Subexponential parameterized algorithms on bounded-genus graphs and H-minor-free graphs', JACM 52(6):866-893, 2005.
note: Standard reference row; all three fields are established for the pinned unweighted decision version on simple undirected graphs.
